name: Hades
title: The Unseen One
summary: Curse enemies with debuffs and lockouts and drag them to their afterlife.
lore: Lord of the Olympian underworld, Hades is normally a cold, implacable deity. Indeed, for a time, even the upheaval of the Shattering scarcely drew his attention. Now that he has decided to act, he dithers over whether the invitation to join Osiris’s “Shadow Council” of underworlds is the proper course. This uncharacteristic indecision threatens to distract him from other vital concerns…
